title: Best Varieties of Papaya
content:
Some of the best varieties of papaya are:
• BARI Papaya-1 (Shahi Papaya): Developed by the Bangladesh Agricultural Research Institute, high-yielding and suitable for local conditions.
• Red Lady: A hybrid variety from Taiwan, high-yielding and well-adapted to Bangladesh climate.
• Sweety: Virus-resistant variety that produces delicious fruits.

title: Good Varieties of Winter Corn
content:
Some of the good varieties of winter corn include:
• BARI Hybrid Corn-5: High-yielding and protein-rich, can yield up to 9-10 tons per hectare in the Rabi season.
• Barnaali, Shuvra, and Khai Corn: Developed by the Bangladesh Wheat and Maize Research Institute, suitable for winter cultivation.
• United-55 and other improved hybrids: Available in the market for high yield and good quality production.
source: Bangladesh Wheat and Maize Research Institute

title: Where to Get Sunflower Seeds
content:
Sunflower seeds can be obtained from the following sources:
• Seed shops
• Local farmers
• Online shops

title: Good Varieties of Sunflower
content:
One of the good varieties of sunflower is **BARI Sunflower-2**:
• Stem diameter: 2.0-2.4 cm
• Inflorescence diameter: 15-18 cm
• Seed color: Black
• Weight of 1000 seeds: 65-70 g
• Number of seeds per head: 450-650
• Oil content: 42%-44%
• Life span: 95-100 days (Rabi), 90-95 days (Kharif)
• Yield per hectare: 2.0-2.3 tons (Rabi), 1.5-1.8 tons (Kharif)

title: Red Lady Papaya Variety
content:
The **Red Lady Papaya** is a Taiwanese high-yielding dwarf hybrid:
• Easy to cultivate and disease-resistant
• Grows up to 10 feet tall
• Starts bearing fruit at 60-80 cm height
• Flower and fruiting in 100-120 days
• Harvestable in 130-140 days
• Each tree produces 70-150 fruits per year
• Yield: 80-100+ kg per tree annually

title: Good Varieties of Sajeena
content:
Some good varieties of **sajeena** include:
• **PKS-2:** Bears fruit within 6 months of planting, fruits available year-round, produces up to 1,600 fruits per tree per year (~2 maunds)
• **BARI Sajeena-1:** High-yielding and suitable for local cultivation

title: Where to Get Bilati Coriander Seeds
content:
Bilati coriander seeds can be obtained from:
• Horticulture Center

title: Best Time to Graft a Lemon Tree
content:
The best time to graft a **lemon tree** is from **May to July**:
• High air humidity and plant cell efficiency improve grafting success
• Can be done at other times if humidity is maintained
• Quick grafting and high success rate

title: High-Yielding Mustard Varieties
content:
Some of the best high-yielding mustard varieties are:
• **BARI Sarisha-18:** Most productive, yields 30-60% more than conventional varieties, canola type producing high-quality oil
• **BARI Sarisha-14:** Another good variety for high yield and quality

title: Best Varieties for Bean Cultivation
content:
Some of the good varieties for **bean cultivation** include:
• **BARI Shim-1, BARI Shim-2, BARI Shim-3 (summer), BARI Shim-4, BARI Shim-5, BARI Shim-6, BARI Shim-7 (summer), BARI Shim-8**
• **Kerala variety:** Yields year-round, more productive in small areas, and popular among farmers

title: Good Variety of Onion
content: A good variety of **onion** is **BARI Pata Onion-1**, suitable for local cultivation and high-yielding.

title: Good Varieties of Early Potatoes
content:
Some good **early potato varieties** include:
• **BARI Alu-8 (Cardinal)**
• **BARI Alu-13**
Other suitable high-yielding varieties for early cultivation are **BARI Alu-12** and **BARI Alu-14**. These varieties have a short life span and give good yields.

title: Varieties of Summer Tomatoes and Planting Time
content:
Some good **summer tomato varieties** are:
• **BARI Tomato-5, BARI Tomato-6, BARI Tomato-11, BARI Tomato-14**
• **BARI Hybrid Tomato-4, BARI Hybrid Tomato-8, BARI Hybrid Tomato-10**
• **Mintu Hybrid**
**Planting time:** Seeds should be sown in **May-June** for best results.

title: Rabi-1 Jute Variety
content:
The **Rabi-1 jute variety** is an improved variety of conventional Tosha jute:
• Slight genetic modifications improve quality and yield
• Plant height: at least 20 cm taller than ordinary Tosha jute
• Fiber content: ~20% higher
• Ash brightness: higher than Tosha jute
• Harvesting time: 100 days (20 days earlier than Tosha jute)
• Tip and base: more even than Tosha jute
• Yield: 20-30% higher than Tosha and Indian varieties
• Enables farmers to cultivate Aman rice on the same land after earlier harvest

title: Modern or advance Jute Variety: BJRI Tosha Jute-6 (O-3820) Characteristics
content:
The **BJRI Tosha Jute-6 (O-3820)** is a modern, high-yielding jute variety:
• **Photosensitive** and completely green plant
• **Leaves:** Long and bulbous
• **Seeds:** Bluish green, suitable for sowing in navel
• **Growth:** Fast-growing, early maturing
• **Fiber quality:** Good, bright golden color

title: Grafting Fruit Trees and Recommended Practices
content:
The **best time to graft fruit trees** is during the **summer and rainy season**, preferably from **May to July** due to high humidity which improves success. Suitable trees for grafting include:
• Mango, Jackfruit, Litchi, Jamrul, Pomegranate
• Rose Jam, Lemon, Guava, Olive, Kamaranga, Amalaki, Plum
Grafting ensures higher success rate and faster fruit production.

title: Litchi Seedling Planting and Growth Guidelines
content:
Guidelines for **planting litchi seedlings**:
• **Spacing:** 8 m x 8 m or 10 m x 10 m
• **Seedlings per hectare:** ~156-157 according to spacing
• **Fruiting:** Grafted seedlings bear fruit in 3-4 years
• **Planting time:** After monsoon, usually March-April
• **Popular varieties:** China-3, Bombay, Bedana, Madraji, Mangalbari, Muzaffarpuri, Kadmi, BARI Litchi-1, BARI Litchi-2, BARI Litchi-3
  - **China-3** is most popular due to early fruiting and good quality

title: Planting Short Coconut Seedlings on Rooftop
content:
Short **coconut seedlings** can be planted in large tubs on rooftops. However:
• Pot size must be large to support growth
• Rooftop planting is generally suitable for short or dwarf trees
• Experts advise caution, as coconut trees are generally not ideal for rooftop cultivation

title: Banana Mango Characteristics
content:
The **Banana Mango** is a unique variety based on Thailand:
• **Shape:** Long, banana-like
• **Color when ripe:** Yellow to pink
• **Taste & flavor:** Sweet (19/20 TSS), edible portion 83%, real mango flavor
• **Skin:** Thin
• **Yield:** More than double conventional varieties
• **Availability:** Usually after June, when other mangoes decrease in the market
• **Cultivation:** Easy and attractive in taste and smell

title: Surjo Dim / Miyazaki Mango in Bangladesh
content:
The **Surjo Dim / Miyazaki Mango**, also known as **Red Mango** in the world market, is available in Bangladesh. 
• Suitable for hilly regions like **Khagrachari**
• Can be cultivated commercially
• Popular for its unique taste and global market demand

title: Sweet Tamarind (BARI Tamarind-1) and Cultivation in Bangladesh
content:
The **sweet tamarind** variety named **BARI Tamarind-1** is cultivated in Bangladesh, but its spread among farmers has been limited.
• **Current cultivation:** About 302 hectares in Bandarban district
• **Average yield:** 19 metric tons per hectare
• **Production target:** 600 metric tons for the current season
• **Varieties in the district:** Common local improved tamarind and sweet tamarind
• **Flowering & fruiting:** Usually 5–6 years after planting; grafted seedlings may bear fruit earlier
• **Farmer adoption:** Low due to long-term nature of the crop, despite government distribution of seedlings

title: BT Brinjal Seed Harvesting and Storage
content:
To store **BT brinjal seeds** properly:
• **Harvest timing:** Collect fruits before they are fully mature; fruit skin should be bright and shiny
• **Fruit check:** Press the fruit gently; if it returns to its shape, it's young and suitable for seed collection
• **Avoid overripe fruit:** Greenish yellow or copper, hard, and spongy skin reduces seed quality
• **Seed quality:** Young seeds give better quality but lower yield
• **Fruit maturity:** Ready to eat about 1 month after flowering
• **Yield:** 17-64 tons per hectare depending on the variety
